portal_data <- read.csv("portal_data.csv")

portal_data$year_f <- as.factor(portal_data$year_f)

light_palette <- c(
  "2023" = "#ecdec3",
  "2024" = "#e3cda6", 
  "2025" = "#dabd88",
  "2026" = "#D1AD6B" 
)

portal_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(portal_data, ggplot2::aes(y = year_f)) +
  
  ggplot2::geom_col(ggplot2::aes(x = bar_left, fill = year_f), width = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(ggplot2::aes(x = bar_right, fill = year_f), width = 0.85) +
  
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(x = 0, label = full_label),
    color      = "#222222",          
    lineheight = 0.85,               
    family     = "Roboto Condensed",
    fontface   = "bold",
    size       = 3.8
  ) +
  
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = light_palette) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = "The player movement era is here",
    subtitle = "Share of players that played at least 500 minutes this season <br>that contributed at least 500 minutes for a <em>different</em> team last season.",
    caption  = "Data via barttorvik.com | Viz by Chris at Bless your chart",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  
  ggplot2::guides(fill = "none") +
  
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc(
    base_family = "Roboto Condensed",
    grid = FALSE
  ) +
  
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle    = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 1.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 25)),
    plot.caption     = ggplot2::element_text(color = "gray60", size = 9, hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20)),
    plot.margin      = ggplot2::margin(30, 30, 30, 30)
  )

ggplot2::ggsave("portal_plot.png",
                portal_plot,
                w = 8.5,
                h = 8.5,
                dpi = 600,
                bg = "floralwhite",
                type = "cairo")

portal_plot
